title: Multi-agent
method: Two official-domain web searches; opened one primary documentation page. No repository content was sent.
source_authority: First-party OpenAI documentation for its Agents API; authoritative for the documented API and OpenAI's guidance, not for Sherlock or Luna.

locators.locator: Overview and When to use subagents, lines 948-953
locators.relevance: Separate context; independent tasks; clear question and expected result; keep short/dependent work in main agent; coordinate shared-file edits.
Example task contract specifies evidence scope, extraction fields, synthesis and no invention.

source_claims: The documentation states that each subagent has its own context and can work in parallel, while the main agent coordinates and combines results.
The documentation recommends subagents for independent tasks and says each task should have a clear question and expected result.
The documentation says to keep short and dependent steps in the main agent, and to coordinate agents that edit the same files.
proposal_inference: Apply this by giving Luna read-only, independent evidence-gathering tasks with explicit scope, output fields, locators and a stop condition; keep integration and cross-layer/proof/native decisions expert-owned.
limitation: The source covers the OpenAI Agents API and general delegation guidance. It does not prescribe prompt length or establish Luna's capabilities or Sherlock-specific outcomes.
